page.overview:
Who is Nick Ross?

Nick Ross is a character in and is portrayed by Frankie Como.

Nick Ross was a deputy in Haddonfield, although, by his own admission, he was a lousy cop. He was always sent on calls with Tom Farrah, although this was fine by him as they got along well. On October 31, 1989, he was sent by Sam Loomis to watch over Tina Williams, who would not listen to the doctor or to Jamie Lloyd's pleads not to leave, as they believed Tina would be in danger. The two deputies drove Tina to the Tower Farm party, where she enjoyed herself, and even played a prank on Ross and Farrah by having her friend Spitz dress up as Michael Myers.

Later in the night, both deputies noticed a man exiting the barn but assumed him to be Spitz again, and told him to be careful with the pitchfork he was holding. Unknown to both, this was the real Michael Myers, who killed the two officers by stabbing them multiple times in the throat with the pitchfork.
